meta.name: gpt-image-skill
meta.description: Generate or edit images using OpenAI GPT Image API (gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1, etc). Triggers: "gpt image", "openai image", "generate image with openai", "draw image", "create image", "image generation", "AI drawing", "图片生成", "AI绘图", "生成图片", "画图". Use this skill whenever the user wants to generate or edit images and mentions OpenAI, GPT, or when OPENAI_API_KEY is available.

copy.tagline: 用 OpenAI 模型生成或编辑图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成或编辑图片
copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit images using OpenAI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate or edit images

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用 OpenAI 的 GPT 图像模型来生成或编辑图片。它会询问你想要的画面描述、尺寸等参数，然后运行脚本创建图片，并告诉你保存位置。
howto.when: 当你提到“gpt image”、“openai image”、“生成图片”、“画图”等关键词，或要求用 OpenAI/GPT 生成或编辑图片时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张日落时的山景图。
say.note: Claude 会询问尺寸等细节，然后生成图片。

say.text: 把这张照片的天空改成星空。
say.note: 需要提供图片文件，Claude 会进行编辑。

say.text: 用 gpt-image-1 模型生成一个水彩风格的猫。
say.note: 指定模型，Claude 会使用该模型生成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate or edit images using OpenAI's GPT Image models. It will ask for a description, size, etc., run a script to create the image, and show you the saved file path.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "gpt image", "openai image", "generate image", "draw image", or ask to generate/edit images using OpenAI/GPT.

say_en.text: Generate a serene mountain landscape at sunset.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details and generate the image.

say_en.text: Edit this photo to add a rainbow in the sky.
say_en.note: Provide the image file; Claude will edit it.

say_en.text: Use gpt-image-1 model to create a watercolor cat portrait.
say_en.note: Specifies the model; Claude uses that model.
